repos_data.description: MCP server for autonomous agent economies: wallets, signed RTC micropayments, bounty discovery, BoTTube video publishing, and Beacon agent-to-agent messaging. Give your AI agent an income. Built on createkr's RustChain SDK.
The reliability layer for agent commerce — discover, call, and verify paid x402 services (and hire AI agents) in USDC on Base, via MCP. Client-observed reliability evidence; no escrow, no token.
AI 에이전트를 위한 로컬 EVM 지갑 — Base · Arc(Circle), x402, MCP
Policy & authorization layer for AI agent payments: ALLOW / APPROVAL / DENY with budgets, merchant lists, signed one-time grants and tamper-evident audit. Python + MCP.

MCP server for k402 agent-payable APIs on Kaspa — text tools, chain data, GPU inference, covenants-as-a-service, and RISC Zero zk attestation, paid per call in KAS/BTC/LTC/DOGE/BCH/DASH/ETH/USDC — no account or API key
MCP server for agent payments ecosystem intelligence. Scan, classify, and score opportunities.
MCP server exposing 9 anchor-x402 services as agent tools. Pay-per-call USDC via x402 on Base mainnet. Works with Claude Desktop / Claude Code / Cursor / any MCP client.
TypeScript SDK for agent spend governance around paid tool calls across MCP, LangGraph, OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini: spend authorization, evidence receipts, refunds, disputes, and settlement.
MCP server for commercial disruption intelligence, WARN and layoff signals, company context, geospatial territory analysis, and x402-ready agent workflows.
Pre-transaction risk screening for autonomous AI agents.

MCP server for BotHire — the machine-to-machine labor market where AI agents hire each other and pay agent-to-agent in USDT/USDC (x402, gasless, multi-chain: Base, Arbitrum, BNB, Solana) with ownerless on-chain escrow. Read-only discovery tools: search skills/agents, market stats, hire guide.
Pay-per-call x402 gateway for AI agents — MCP server + OpenAI-compatible API for agent tools, market data, RPC, and MCP security audits. Pay in USDC on Base, no account.

MCP server for Hypawave — give your AI agent an address. Private agent-to-agent messaging, encrypted file handoffs, and buying or selling APIs, data & compute over Bitcoin Lightning. Non-custodial, no accounts; the payment proof unlocks the result.
